ive been doordashing for 5-6 years. the average income was cut in half about a year ago, and steadily declining for the last two years. it is now averaging at Less than my state's minimum wage, averaging 15 an hour, wheras i could average 30-50 an hour a few years ago. its gotten quite bad.. its a combination of dd raising their fees (while not raising driver base pay), restaurants raising their prices, and people having less money to blow, and a severe oversaturation of drivers because everyone is desperate for extra funds

as for the wait times that customers complain about, while there may be some crappy drivers out there, most of that is NOT the driver's fault, it is the merchant who takes their good ol time and wants drivers to wait in their lobby for 20 minutes. and the restaurants Lie by marking an order as complete, while it is still cooking, so that they don't get penalized by DD.. when the wait time changes on the customer end, it is mostly because the restaurant is still making the food when the driver arrives and sometimes have not even started making the order yet.. also, dd is notoriously bad at estimating drive times, it uses crappy a.i. that expects drivers to break the law and speed

The worst one was when she placed an order that included items for the 4th of July. The order was delivered and all of the 4th of July items were missing (stolen) from the order. I hope that driver got fired over this.

comments.author: @CavalierConfessional
comments.text: I miss dedicated restaurant delivery drivers. You know, the pizza guy. Delivering your pizza hot and fresh. The restaurants thought they would save money, they haven't-it costs MORE to use these services than paying for their own delivery driver. I do not use them any more. Between the markup on the food the restaurant has to do to cover the fees imposed by the companies and the fee the company charges and the tip. It is not worth it. For that kind of money I can get up off the sofa and get it my damn self!
